prompt:
Create a 3x2 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG, battle sprites.

Image 1 is a POSE GUIDE: grey mannequins on white, one per cell. Draw the SAME character once in every cell, matching that cell's mannequin pose, position and size exactly. Light grey limbs are the far side, dark grey limbs the near side; the light patch and nose bump on the head show which way the face points.

Image 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE only (bead versions of classic battle sprites): match its chunky proportions (about 2.5 heads tall, oversized head, big fists and boots), black outlines around and between parts, and flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour. Do NOT copy those characters and do NOT draw bead texture.

Image 3 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved sprite sheet of a DIFFERENT character from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, figure height, proportions, outline weight, shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy its costume, colours, hair or face.

The grey mannequins are ONLY a pose guide: never draw grey limbs or grey shapes; draw the character's own sleeves, hands and held items in every cell.

FACE: every cell must show a clearly readable face drawn at the same sprite-pixel size as the body: two dark eyes, eyebrows and a mouth, also when hurt, kneeling, knocked down, casting or seen in profile. Hoods, hair and hats frame the face but never cover it. (Back views show no face.)

Render as true pixel art: each character about 56-60 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no soft shading. Side view: the nose points LEFT and only one eye is visible.

Character: tan-skinned martial artist with short black hair and a white headband, orange sleeveless gi with a white belt, orange wide trousers, simple brown sandals, bare muscular arms with cloth hand wraps; bare fists raised, no weapon. Keep every costume detail identical in every cell.

Cells:
- top-left cell: battle stance, knees bent, fists raised.
- top-middle cell: lunging forward, weapon thrust to the left.
- top-right cell: arm raised up and forward to cast a spell, face clearly visible.
- bottom-left cell: recoiling backward from a hit, eyes shut.
- bottom-middle cell: collapsed, kneeling low with head bowed.
- bottom-right cell: triumphant, weapon raised overhead, face visible.

Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no grid lines, no borders, no text or labels.
Avoid: multiple weapons, extra swords, floating objects, props on the ground, duplicate characters, facing right, blurry, soft shading, gradient, airbrush, photo, 3d render, realistic, text, watermark, frame, border, grid lines, shadow on ground.
